issue_context.title: Metrics page breaks with polling enabled
issue_context.body:
I've just upgraded to Sidekiq 7.0 and noticed that the metrics page breaks when the polling is enabled and it refreshes the data. The first load works, but then the graph breaks.

Ruby version: 3.1.2
Rails version: 7.0.4
Sidekiq / Pro / Enterprise version(s): 7.0
comments:
The metrics data does not auto-refresh just yet. You’ll need to manually refresh for now.

review_comments:
We also want to disable it for `/sidekiq`, which works with `current_path.blank?`.

But maybe it should be:

```ruby
def pollable?
  return false if current_path.blank? # /sidekiq
  
  NOT_POLLABLE.none? { |path| current_path.starts_with?(path) }
end
```
One way to make Ruby faster is to avoid all those little unnecessary allocations, like `split` which allocates an array. I'll merge this and tweak the code so you can see how I would implement it.
